name: 4-methoxytryptamine
summary: 4-Methoxytryptamine (4-MeO-T; developmental code name PAL-548) is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families. It is the O-methyl derivative of 4-hydroxytryptamine (4-HT) and a positional isomer of 5-methoxytryptamine and 6-methoxytryptamine.

pharmacology.text: The drug has been found to act as a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor full agonist, with an EC50 of 9.02 nM and an Emax of 108%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體的實驗室研究，不是藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体的实验室研究，不是药品。

fact.en: It is a positional isomer of 5-methoxytryptamine, a natural compound closely related to melatonin. Moving the methoxy group by one place on the ring makes a very different drug.
fact.zh: 它是5-甲氧基色胺的位置異構物；5-甲氧基色胺是一種與褪黑激素密切相關的天然化合物。只要把甲氧基在環上挪動一個位置，就成了作用很不一樣的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它是5-甲氧基色胺的位置异构物；5-甲氧基色胺是一种与褪黑激素密切相关的天然化合物。只要把甲氧基在环上挪动一个位置，就成了作用很不一样的药物。
